name: sd-face2
prompt: A man in his late twenties with warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, light stubble, cream chunky knit sweater over a white t-shirt, sits at a wooden kitchen table by a sunny window with an open laptop, screen facing away from camera. He types a short question, pauses, then taps three keys at once with his left hand and looks at the screen, waiting. Morning sun through sheer curtains, handheld, 35mm film look, realistic. No text, no logos.
